_readme: Registry of every system John runs from this repo. The hourly GitHub Action checks each one and writes the result to the status page. Add a system here and it appears on the page. check.type: http | branch | pr | none.

systems.name: Neon store (compression wear)

checks.label: Live server
checks.note: Runs only inside a Claude session (local Postgres). Not reachable from the internet and wiped when the session ends.

systems.fix: Pick permanent free hosting (own PC, or free web tier + free Postgres) and add its /health URL here as an http check.
